from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "PCR plate prep: 18ul master mix + 2ul template",

    for i, well in enumerate(source_plate.wells()):
        liquid_name = f"sample_{i+1}"
        protocol.define_liquid(
            name=liquid_name,
            description=f"Sample {i+1}",
            display_color=f"#{i:06X}"
        )
        # Load 10 ul of each sample into its well
        well.load_liquid(liquid=liquid_name, volume=10)
    
    # Load master mix into reservoir well A1
    reservoir_well = reservoir["A1"]
    reservoir_well.load_liquid(liquid="master mix", volume=2000)
    
    # Load the p20 multi-channel pipette
    p20_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p20_multi_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    
    # Get all destination and source wells in order
    dest_wells = list(pcr_plate.wells())
    src_wells = list(source_plate.wells())

        p20_multi.aspirate(2, src_group)
        # Dispense 2 ul into each destination well
        p20_multi.dispense(2, dest_group)
    
    # Drop tip
    p20_multi.drop_tip()

from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "PCR plate prep: 18ul master mix + 2ul template",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", "1")
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", "2")
    pcr_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", "3")
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", "4")
    
    # Define master mix
    master_mix = protocol.define_liquid(
        name="master mix",
        description="Master mix for PCR",
        display_color="#FF0000"
    )
    # Load master mix into reservoir well A1
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=2000)
    
    # Define each sample and load 10 ul into its well
    for i, well in enumerate(source_plate.wells()):
        sample_liquid = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"sample_{i+1}",
            description=f"Sample {i+1}",
            display_color=f"#{i:06X}"
        )
        well.load_liquid(liquid=sample_liquid, volume=10)
    
    # Load the p20 single-channel pipette
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    
    # Process each well individually
    p20.pick_up_tip()
    for i, (dest_well, src_well) in enumerate(zip(pcr_plate.wells(), source_plate.wells())):
        # Add 18 ul master mix
        p20.aspirate(18, reservoir["A1"])
        p20.dispense(18, dest_well)
        # Add 2 ul template
        p20.aspirate(2, src_well)
        p20.dispense(2, dest_well)
    # Drop tip
    p20.drop_tip()
```

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "PCR plate prep: 18ul master mix + 2ul template",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", "1")
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", "2")
    pcr_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", "3")
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", "4")
    
    # Define master mix
    master_mix = protocol.define_liquid(
        name="master mix",
        description="Master mix for PCR",
        display_color="#FF0000"
    )
    # Load master mix into reservoir well A1 (sufficient volume)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=2000)
    
    # Define each sample and load 30 ul into its well (to ensure enough depth)
    for i, well in enumerate(source_plate.wells()):
        sample_liquid = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"sample_{i+1}",
            description=f"Sample {i+1}",
            display_color=f"#{i:06X}"
        )
        well.load_liquid(liquid=sample_liquid, volume=30)  # increased volume
    
    # Load the p20 multi-channel pipette
    p20_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p20_multi_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    
    # Process in batches of 8
    dest_wells = list(pcr_plate.wells())
    src_wells = list(source_plate.wells())
    
    for i in range(0, 96, 8):
        dest_group = dest_wells[i:i+8]
        src_group = src_wells[i:i+8]
        
        # Fresh tip for each batch
        p20_multi.pick_up_tip()
        
        # Add 18 ul master mix to all 8 destination wells
        p20_multi.aspirate(18, reservoir["A1"])
        for well in dest_group:
            p20_multi.dispense(18, well)
        
        # Add 2 ul template from each source well
        p20_multi.aspirate(2, src_group)
        for well in dest_group:
            p20_multi.dispense(2, well)
        
        # Drop tip after batch
        p20_multi.drop_tip()"}

        description="Master mix for PCR",
        display_color="#FF0000"
    )
    # Load master mix into reservoir well A1 (sufficient volume)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=2000)
    
    # Define each sample and load 30 ul into its well (to ensure enough depth)
    for i, well in enumerate(source_plate.wells()):
        sample_liquid = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"sample_{i+1}",
            description=f"Sample {i+1}",
            display_color=f"#{i:06X}"
        )
        well.load_liquid(liquid=sample_liquid, volume=30)  # increased volume
    
    # Load the p20 multi-channel pipette
    p20_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p20_multi_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    
    # Process in batches of 8
    dest_wells = list(pcr_plate.wells())
    src_wells = list(source_plate.wells())
    
    for i in range(0, 96, 8):
        dest_group = dest_wells[i:i+8]
        src_group = src_wells[i:i+8]
        
        # Fresh tip for each batch
        p20_multi.pick_up_tip()
        
        # Add 18 ul master mix to all 8 destination wells

        for well in dest_group:
            p20_multi.dispense(18, well)
        
        # Add 2 ul template from each source well
        p20_multi.aspirate(2, src_group)
        for well in dest_group:
            p20_multi.dispense(2, well)
        
        # Drop tip after batch
        p20_multi.drop_tip()"}

        name="master mix",
        description="Master mix for PCR",
        display_color="#FF0000"
    )
    # Load master mix into reservoir well A1 (sufficient volume)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=2000)
    
    # Define water for no-template control
    water = protocol.define_liquid(
        name="water",
        description="Water",
        display_color="#0000FF"
    )
    # Load water into reservoir well A2 (sufficient volume)
    reservoir["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=30)
    
    # Define each sample and load 30 ul into its well (to ensure enough depth)
    for i, well in enumerate(source_plate.wells()):
        sample_liquid = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"sample_{i+1}",

            display_color=f"#{i:06X}"
        )
        well.load_liquid(liquid=sample_liquid, volume=30)  # increased volume

    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])

        # Add 2 ul template or water (fresh tip)

        if i == 95:  # no-template control well (last well)
            # aspirate 2 ul water for no-template control
            p20.aspirate(2, reservoir["A2"].bottom(0.5))
        else:
            # aspirate 2 ul from source well (aspirate from bottom to stay in liquid)
            p20.aspirate(2, src_well.bottom(0.5))
        p20.dispense(2, dest_well)
        # Mix the well to ensure proper blending
        p20.mix(5, 16, dest_well)
        # Drop tip
        p20.drop_tip()"}

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "PCR plate prep: 18ul master mix + 2ul template",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", "1")
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", "2")
    pcr_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", "3")
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", "4")
    
    # Define master mix
    master_mix = protocol.define_liquid(
        name="master mix",
        description="Master mix for PCR",
        display_color="#FF0000"
    )
    # Load master mix into reservoir well A1 (sufficient volume)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=2000)
    
    # Define water for no-template control
    water = protocol.define_liquid(
        name="water",
        description="Water",
        display_color="#0000FF"
    )
    # Load water into reservoir well A2 (sufficient volume to avoid air aspiration)
    reservoir["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=200)
    
    # Define each sample and load 30 ul into its well (to ensure enough depth)
    for i, well in enumerate(source_plate.wells()):
        sample_liquid = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=f"sample_{i+1}",
            description=f"Sample {i+1}",
            display_color=f"#{i:06X}"
        )
        well.load_liquid(liquid=sample_liquid, volume=30)  # increased volume
    
    # Load the p20 multi-channel pipette and single-channel pipette
    p20_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p20_multi_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    p20_single = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    
    # Process in batches of 8
    dest_wells = list(pcr_plate.wells())
    src_wells = list(source_plate.wells())
    
    for i in range(0, 96, 8):
        dest_group = dest_wells[i:i+8]
        src_group = src_wells[i:i+8]
        
        # Transfer 18 ul master mix to all 8 destination wells (new tip automatically picked up)
        p20_multi.transfer(18, reservoir["A1"], dest_group, new_tip='always')
        # Drop tip after master mix transfer
        p20_multi.drop_tip()
        
        # Transfer 2 ul template (or water for no-template control) to destination wells
        if i == 95:  # no-template control well (last well)
            # Transfer 2 ul water to the specific well
            p20_single.transfer(2, reservoir["A2"], dest_group[0], new_tip='always')
            # Mix the well to ensure proper blending
            p20_single.mix(5, 16, dest_group[0])
        else:
            # Transfer 2 ul template from each source well to each destination well
            p20_single.transfer(2, src_group, dest_group, new_tip='always')
            # Mix each destination well to ensure proper blending
            for well in dest_group:
                p20_single.mix(5, 16, well)
        # Drop tip after template transfer
        p20_single.drop_tip()"}
